- [ ] `npm test` passes

- [ ] Security impact assessed (paths, commands, secrets, permissions)
- [ ] `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` updated when user-visible
- [ ] User-facing strings are Turkish; code identifiers, logs, and filenames stay English
- [ ] Bilingual docs updated together (English canonical + `*.tr.md` counterpart)
